section.title: Warm Up Activity
section.para: Diego is walking home from school at a constant rate. This graph represents function \(d\), which gives his distance from home, in kilometers, \(m\) minutes since leaving the school.
Use the graph to find or estimate:

image.alt: Graph of line. Horizontal axis, 0 to 24 by 4’s, minutes since leaving school. Vertical axis, 0 to 3 by point 5’s, kilometers from home. Line starts at about 0 comma 2 point 2 5, and ends at 20 comma 0.

div.para: \(d(0)=2.25\); Zero minutes after Diego has left school, he is 2.25 kilometers from home, or Diego’s school is a little more than 2 kilometers from his house.

list.item: What is \(d(0)\), and what does it represent in the situation? Enter your answer here:

div.para: \(m\) is approximately 10.5. After approximately 10.5 minutes, Diego is 1 kilometer from home.

list.item: What does \(d(m)=1\) mean in the context of the problem, and what is \(m\)?

div.para: \(m\) is 20. After 20 minutes, Diego is 0 kilometers from home, or it takes Diego 20 minutes to walk the 2.25 kilometers home from school.

list.item: What does \(d(m)=0\) mean in the context of the problem, and what is \(m\)?
